a.label: Grade 4
a.body:
Add two 4-digit and 5-digit whole numbers with carrying, up to a sum of 100 000.

Do dukan se cheezein khareedein — dono ke daam jorne ke liye kya karte hain?

3 250 + 1 780 — rupees saved in two months
12 400 + 9 600 — bricks for two walls

b.label: Grade 5
b.body:
Add two 5-digit and 6-digit whole numbers with carrying, up to a sum of 1 000 000.

Do bade numbers jorte waqt carry kaise sambhalte hain?

145 000 + 82 500 — people at two cricket matches
236 400 + 190 600 — litres of water in two tanks

sections.heading: Carrying Race
sections.label: duration: 27-35 min
sections.body: Whole class. Teacher writes a two-number sum; the first pair to add it correctly with every carry marked wins a point.

sections.heading: Line Up The Places
sections.body: Write the numbers one under the other so Ones sit under Ones, Tens under Tens, Hundreds under Hundreds. A neat place-value column is half the work.

sections.heading: Add From The Right
sections.body: Always start at the Ones column and move left: Ones, then Tens, then Hundreds, then Thousands.

sections.heading: Carrying — Ten Ones Make One Ten
sections.body: When a column adds to ten or more, write the Ones digit and carry the extra to the next column on the left. Ten Ones become one Ten; ten Tens become one Hundred.

sections.heading: Concept Note
sections.body: Addition means putting two amounts together to find the total. We line up the places and add column by column from the right, carrying to the next place when a column makes ten or more.

sections.heading: Carrying Race
sections.label: duration: 35-42 min
sections.body: 2 min with Grade 4 <-> 2 min with Grade 5. Never more than 3 minutes with one class.
